title: Cute items, no notice or description; no goals
text: We are in month two and the items have been cool. Wish there was some sort of notice saying it's coming and a heads up on what is coming so you can prepare. For the price and the value of the item, there should be a little more of a "club environment" and notice.  Like what you are sending and why it was picked. This seems sloppy and without goals.
label: neutral
